mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over the last two months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances following HOUST increases, or the correlation between HOUST increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last two months signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within the last month, it signals a strong labor market and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the last two months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances following RSAFS increases, or the correlation between RSAFS increases and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
